weapons.name: H6 Big Boy Rifle .45 Colt
weapons.source_note: Henry Repeating Arms H6 Big Boy Rifle .45 Colt, Model Number H006GC, Additional Specifications: 'Barrel Length 20" | Barrel Type Octagon Blued Steel | Rate of Twist 1:16 | Overall Length 38.5" | Weight 8.68 lbs.' 1:16 in = 406.4 mm; 20 in = 508 mm; 8.68 lb = 3.937 kg. The corpus twist of 0.508 m is not supported by the maker page: the 1:20 rows on the same page belong to the .44 Magnum and .44 Special variants.

weapons.name: P-3AT
weapons.source_note: KelTec P3AT specifications table: 'Caliber .380ACP 9x17mm | Weight Unloaded 7.7oz 218g | Overall Length 5.2" 132mm | Barrel Length 2.7" 68mm'. The table states no rifling row, so the twist stays absent and the lead stays open. Mass and barrel length are stated in both units on the page.

weapons.name: SIG Sauer P238
weapons.source_note: SIG SAUER P238/P938 Operator's Manual 17SIG2387 Rev 03, specifications table, P238 column: 'Caliber .380ACP (9mm short) | Barrel Length 2.7" | Weight w/ Magazine 15.2 oz'. 15.2 oz = 0.431 kg with an empty magazine; 2.7 in = 68.6 mm. The manual states no twist rate and the sigsauer.com product pages carry no specification table, so the twist stays absent.
